program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.
This program requires 128 sh in all, not 120.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.
Optional concentrations (Acting, Music Theatre, Pre-Teaching, Design / Technical) need a successful audition and faculty review; at least 16.5 credits from one puts it on the transcript.

Biology or Chemistry two-course sequence. The guide also allows a Computer Science sequence (8 credits toward a CS minor or CUGS) or another sequence approved by the advisor, which cannot be listed as fixed courses.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.
The guide is effective Fall 2022; students with other catalog years follow it in these test cases.

Linear Algebra and Differential Equations, or PHYS00330 Mathematical Methods for Physics plus one more Restricted Elective. The guide prints 'MATH 01 231 Linear Algebra / MATH 01 210 Differential Equations'; in the Section Tally MATH01210 is LINEAR ALGEBRA and MATH01231 is ORDINARY DIFFER EQUAT, the same pair with the numbers swapped.

Any 300+ level Physics (PHYS 00), 200+ level Astronomy (ASTR 11), Geology, 300+ level Engineering, 200+ level Math, 200+ level Chemistry (except Chemistry in the Environment), 200+ level Computer Science, or Biology course; ENGR01281 Material Science or INTR01486 Interdisciplinary Materials Science. At most 3 sh of Physics/Astronomy Research I-IV and 4 sh of Physics Learning Assistant count. The guide names the Chemistry exception only by title; no 200+ level CHEM course in the Fall 2026 Section Tally has that title, so none is excluded.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.
The guide is effective Fall 2022; students with other catalog years follow it in these test cases.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.
Grade of C or better in all courses satisfying Major requirements.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.
Grade of C- or better in all courses satisfying Major requirements.
The registrar lists this guide for all students who entered Fall 2021 or later; the PDF says Effective Fall 2018.

program_requirements.title: Communicative Literacy
program_requirements.notes: The three courses or their official equivalents; the only Rowan Core credits counted in the Rowan Core section.

program_requirements.title: Artistic Literacy
program_requirements.notes: Any course designated ARTL; its credits count in another section.

program_requirements.title: Global Literacy
program_requirements.notes: Any course designated GLBL; its credits count in another section.

program_requirements.title: Humanistic Literacy
program_requirements.notes: Any course designated HUML; its credits count in another section.

program_requirements.title: Quantitative Literacy
program_requirements.notes: Any course designated QNTL; its credits count in another section.

program_requirements.title: Scientific Literacy
program_requirements.notes: Any course designated SCIL; its credits count in another section.

program_requirements.title: Broad-Based Literature Attribute
program_requirements.notes: Any one course with the LIT attribute; its credits count in another section.

program_requirements.title: Writing Intensive Attribute
program_requirements.notes: Any one course with the WI attribute; its credits count in another section.

program_requirements.title: Rowan Seminar Attribute
program_requirements.notes: Any one course with the RS attribute; its credits count in another section.

program_requirements.title: Philosophy bank
program_requirements.notes: Choose one PHIL course from the bank.

program_requirements.title: General Biology: Human Focus or Biology I
program_requirements.notes: Satisfies Scientific Literacy. The guide's alternative is printed as 'BIOL 0110 Biology I', a truncated course id, so it is not listed here.

program_requirements.title: Essentials of Psychology
program_requirements.notes: Satisfies Humanistic Literacy.
PSY01199 in the first term as a major; PSY02300 needs junior status; PSY01499 in the last term.
A sequence: PSY01301 first, then PSY07301 (B in PSY01301), then PSY07400 / PSY07303 (B in PSY07301), then the advanced courses. PSY07400 and PSY01420 are offered Fall only, PSY01421 Spring only.

program_requirements.title: Child & Adolescent Development or Lifespan Development
Psychology of Personality or Social Psychology
Cognitive Psychology or Learning and Behaviorism

program_requirements.notes: 15 credits from any psychology course except PSY09210, PSY09209 and PSY09218.

program_requirements.title: Free Electives
program_requirements.notes: Any credits not used above; choose ones that satisfy unmet Rowan Core or Rowan Experience requirements.

sections.title: Non-Program Courses
sections.notes: Courses here cannot be in the major department. The guide names a PHIL course (3 sh) and BIOL01113 (4 sh) under an 18 sh subtotal; the other non-program credits are not itemized.

sections.title: Major Requirements
sections.notes: Introductory 3, Professional Development 5, Research 22, Basic Core 15, Psychology Electives 15.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.

sections.title: Non-Program Courses

sections.title: Major Requirements
sections.notes: Foundational 17, Fundamental 15, Psychology Electives 3.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.
The registrar lists this guide for students who entered Fall 2025 or later; the PDF says Effective Fall 2022.
Prerequisites come from the guide's notes ('PSY 01107/8'): PSY01107 or PSY01108; only PSY01107 is listed here.

program_requirements.notes: Satisfies Scientific Literacy. The guide's alternative is printed as 'BIOL 0110 Biology I', a truncated course id, so it is not listed here.

program_requirements.title: Essentials of Psychology
program_requirements.notes: Satisfies Humanistic Literacy.
PSY01199 in the first term as a major; PSY02300 needs junior status; PSY01499 in the last term.
A sequence: PSY01301 first, then PSY07301 (B in PSY01301), then PSY07400 / PSY07303 (B in PSY07301), then the advanced courses. PSY07400 and PSY01420 are offered Fall only, PSY01421 Spring only.

program_requirements.title: Child & Adolescent Development or Lifespan Development
Psychology of Personality or Social Psychology
Cognitive Psychology or Learning and Behaviorism

program_requirements.notes: 15 credits from any psychology course except PSY09210, PSY09209 and PSY09218.

program_requirements.title: Free Electives
program_requirements.notes: Any credits not used above; choose ones that satisfy unmet Rowan Core or Rowan Experience requirements.

sections.title: Non-Program Courses
sections.notes: Courses here cannot be in the major department. The guide names a PHIL course (3 sh) and BIOL01113 (4 sh) under an 18 sh subtotal; the other non-program credits are not itemized.

sections.title: Major Requirements
sections.notes: Introductory 3, Professional Development 5, Research 22, Basic Core 15, Psychology Electives 15.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.
PSY09305's prerequisite is PSY01107 and (PSY09209 or PSY09218); the either-or part cannot be written as a prerequisites entry, so only PSY01107 is listed (this student has PSY09218).

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.

Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.
Grade of C- or better in all courses satisfying Major requirements.
Coordinator: Chanelle Rose.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.
Graduate courses may be counted as restricted electives when taken as senior privilege or as part of the accelerated BS/MS program.
The guide names no effective term; the registrar lists it for students who entered Fall 2024 or later.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.
Grade of C- or better in all courses satisfying Major requirements.
GPA of at least 2.0 in Foundation, Upper-Level, Concentration and Cross-Concentration courses.
Concentration courses may not be taken more than twice.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.
Overall GPA of 2.5 or better in all courses that satisfy major requirements.
The guide is for students entering the major Fall 2023 and after.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.

A grade of C- or better in Calculus I, Discrete Structures, Introduction to Object Oriented Programming, Object Oriented Programming/Data Abstraction, Computer Organization, and Data Structures and Algorithms is required for graduation and to take any course that has one of them as a prerequisite, whether taken here or transferred.
Graduate courses may be counted as restricted electives when taken as senior privilege or as part of the accelerated BS/MS program.
The guide is effective Fall 2026; students with other catalog years follow it in these test cases.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.

A grade of C- or better in Calculus I, Discrete Structures, Introduction to Object Oriented Programming, Object Oriented Programming/Data Abstraction, Computer Organization, and Data Structures and Algorithms is required for graduation and to take any course that has one of them as a prerequisite, whether taken here or transferred.
Graduate courses may be counted as restricted electives when taken as senior privilege or as part of the accelerated BS/MS program.
The guide is effective Fall 2026; students with other catalog years follow it in these test cases.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.
Overall GPA of 2.5 or better in all courses that satisfy major requirements.
The guide is for students entering the major Fall 2023 and after.

A sequence: PSY01301 first, then PSY07301 (B in PSY01301), then PSY07400 / PSY07303 (B in PSY07301), then the advanced courses. PSY07400 and PSY01420 are offered Fall only, PSY01421 Spring only.

program_requirements.title: Child & Adolescent Development or Lifespan Development
Psychology of Personality or Social Psychology
Cognitive Psychology or Learning and Behaviorism

program_requirements.notes: 15 credits from any psychology course except PSY09210, PSY09209 and PSY09218.

program_requirements.title: Free Electives
program_requirements.notes: Any credits not used above; choose ones that satisfy unmet Rowan Core or Rowan Experience requirements.

sections.title: Non-Program Courses
sections.notes: Courses here cannot be in the major department. The guide names a PHIL course (3 sh) and BIOL01113 (4 sh) under an 18 sh subtotal; the other non-program credits are not itemized.

sections.title: Major Requirements
sections.notes: Introductory 3, Professional Development 5, Research 22, Basic Core 15, Psychology Electives 15.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.
Grade of C- or better in all courses satisfying Major requirements.
The registrar lists this guide for all students who entered Fall 2021 or later; the PDF says Effective Fall 2018.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.
Grade of C- or better in all courses satisfying Major requirements.
2.0 major GPA required for graduation.
30 credits in upper-level courses, including at least 18 upper-level (300-400) Sociology credits.
